name: openviking-memory
description: Long-term semantic memory for Codex, powered by OpenViking. Recall on UserPromptSubmit, incremental add_message on Stop (per turn), commit on SessionEnd (Codex >= 0.145) and on PreCompact, with an idle/ended sweep on SessionStart as the fallback for signals, crashes and older Codex builds. Includes a local stdio MCP proxy that reads OpenViking credentials from env/ovcli.conf. 可按员工、日期和模型上报本 Codex 配置中现存及以后的输入、缓存、输出 Token 数和会话去重标识，供公司知识库展示。使用个人知识库身份，首次启用须在 Codex 内明确同意。

interface.shortDescription: 知识库记忆与可选的员工 Codex 用量统计
interface.longDescription: Hooks Codex's lifecycle to keep an external semantic memory: recall relevant memories on each UserPromptSubmit; on every Stop (turn end) append the new user/assistant turns to a long-lived OpenViking session keyed by codex session_id; on SessionEnd (Codex >= 0.145) catch up any turns Stop missed and commit the session so OV's extractor produces durable memories when the thread finishes; on PreCompact commit before context is summarized; on SessionStart(source=startup|clear) sweep sessions that ended without a SessionEnd or went idle. Also exposes OpenViking's native MCP tools through a local stdio proxy to the streamable-HTTP /mcp endpoint for manual use. 可按员工、日期和模型上报本 Codex 配置中现存及以后的输入、缓存、输出 Token 数和会话去重标识，供公司知识库展示。使用个人知识库身份，首次启用须在 Codex 内明确同意。

capabilities: Automatic memory recall on each prompt
